mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon ( id, user_id, coupon_template_id, status, valid_start_at, valid_end_at, received_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{couponTemplateId}, 'UNUSED', #{validStartAt}, #{validEndAt}, #{receivedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, coupon_template_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId" FROM user_coupon WHERE coupon_template_id = #{couponTemplateId} AND status IN ('UNUSED', 'LOCKED', 'USED')
mapper.sql: encode(uc.id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", uc.user_id AS "userId", encode(uc.coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", uc.status AS "status", uc.valid_start_at AS "validStartAt", uc.valid_end_at AS "validEndAt", uc.received_at AS "receivedAt", uc.locked_order_no AS "lockedOrderNo", uc.locked_at AS "lockedAt", uc.used_order_no AS "usedOrderNo", uc.used_at AS "usedAt", uc.version AS "userCouponVersion", uc.created_at AS "userCouponCreatedAt", uc.updated_at AS "userCouponUpdatedAt"

encode(uc.id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(uc.coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", uc.user_id AS "userId", uc.status AS "userCouponStatus", uc.valid_start_at AS "validStartAt", uc.valid_end_at AS "validEndAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_coupon uc WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status IN ('UNUSED', 'LOCKED') ORDER BY uc.received_at DESC, uc.created_at DESC

WITH target AS ( SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_template_id FROM user_coupon uc WHERE uc.id = #{userCouponId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'UNUSED' AND uc.valid_start_at <= #{now} AND uc.valid_end_at > #{now} ), updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon uc SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_order_no = #{orderNo}, locked_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 FROM target t WHERE uc.id = t.id RETURNING uc.id, t.coupon_template_id ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'UNUSED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE locked_order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING id, coupon_template_id, user_id ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", user_id AS "userId" FROM updated

WITH raw AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{ordersJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint ) ), updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon c SET status = 'UNUSED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM raw WHERE c.locked_order_no = raw.order_no AND (raw.user_id IS NULL OR c.user_id = raw.user_id) AND c.status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING raw.order_no, c.user_id, c.id, c.coupon_template_id ) SELECT order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'USED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, used_order_no = #{orderNo}, used_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE locked_order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING id, coupon_template_id, user_id ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", user_id AS "userId" FROM updated

WITH raw AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{ordersJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint, paid_at_epoch_ms bigint, order_amount_yuan numeric, discount_amount_yuan numeric ) ), updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon c SET status = 'USED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, used_order_no = raw.order_no, used_at = to_timestamp(raw.paid_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0), updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM raw WHERE c.locked_order_no = raw.order_no AND c.status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING raw.order_no, c.user_id, raw.order_amount_yuan, raw.discount_amount_yuan, c.id, c.coupon_template_id ) SELECT order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", order_amount_yuan AS "orderAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId" FROM updated
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'UNUSED' AND valid_end_at < NOW()
